profile.title: GridStory ASVS 5.0.0 Level 2-oriented security profile
profile.statement: This is a project-specific selection and applicability record, not an ASVS certification or a claim that every ASVS L2 requirement has been independently verified.

statusDefinitions.verified: Current implementation and automated or inspectable evidence support this project requirement.
statusDefinitions.partial: Some controls exist, but the stated gap or independent deployment evidence remains.
statusDefinitions.planned: Required before v1 GA and linked to a delivery task.
statusDefinitions.conditional: Required when the named optional deployment feature or topology is used.

chapters.name: Encoding and Sanitization
chapters.rationale: GridStory accepts structured content, URLs, SVG, query expressions, and database inputs.

chapters.name: Validation and Business Logic
chapters.rationale: Authoring, workflows, releases, imports, uploads, and replay have ordered business invariants.

chapters.name: Web Frontend Security
chapters.rationale: Studio, preview, private assets, and delivery run in browsers.

chapters.name: API and Web Service
chapters.rationale: GridStory exposes REST and GraphQL APIs.

chapters.name: File Handling
chapters.rationale: Assets and logical archives cross file boundaries.

chapters.name: Authentication
chapters.rationale: The core has OIDC/service-token foundations; the production identity adapter and policy are deployment work.

chapters.name: Session Management
chapters.rationale: Applies when the in-memory foundation is replaced by the production browser-session deployment.

chapters.name: Authorization
chapters.rationale: Every management capability and data object is role/grant and tenant scoped.

chapters.name: Self-contained Tokens
chapters.rationale: Preview, cursor, and asset grants carry signed context and expiry.

chapters.name: OAuth and OIDC
chapters.rationale: Required for the planned production OIDC relying-party adapter, not the development header identity.

chapters.name: Cryptography
chapters.rationale: GridStory hashes audit/archive/token secrets and signs grants, cursors, and webhooks.

chapters.name: Secure Communication
chapters.rationale: Browser, API, database, object-store, IdP, and adapter communication require protected transport in production.

chapters.name: Configuration
chapters.rationale: Security depends on origin, host, secret, storage, database, worker, and adapter configuration.

chapters.name: Data Protection
chapters.rationale: Draft content, credentials, private assets, actor attributes, and operational records require differentiated protection.

chapters.name: Secure Coding and Architecture
chapters.rationale: The monorepo, external dependencies, framework-neutral interfaces, projections, and adapters need secure lifecycle controls.

chapters.name: Security Logging and Error Handling
chapters.rationale: Audit, authentication, authorization, adapter, and operational failures need safe, correlatable handling.

chapters.name: WebRTC
chapters.rationale: GridStory has no WebRTC feature, media peer connection, signaling service, or WebRTC data channel.

requirements.title: Trusted-layer input validation
requirements.statement: All untrusted API, archive, content, query, workflow, release, and adapter inputs SHALL be positively validated at a trusted server/core boundary before security-relevant use.

requirements.title: Database injection prevention
requirements.statement: Repositories SHALL use parameterized database statements and SHALL NOT concatenate untrusted values into executable SQL.

requirements.title: Safe structured rendering
requirements.statement: GridStory SHALL store validated structured content only; rich text, URLs, Markdown-like content, and application-owned rendering SHALL use context-appropriate encoding or sanitization and SHALL never execute editor-authored code.

requirements.title: SVG sanitization
requirements.statement: Uploaded SVG SHALL be rejected or sanitized to remove executable, embedded, external-reference, event, style, entity, and processing-instruction content before delivery.

requirements.title: Outbound request and SSRF policy
requirements.statement: Server-originated requests SHALL use HTTPS where applicable, explicit host/protocol policy, no credential-bearing URLs, no redirects by default, bounded timeouts, and infrastructure egress/DNS enforcement.

requirements.title: Atomic high-value operations
requirements.statement: Content publication, releases, imports, and outbox creation SHALL either commit their complete validated state or leave the previous correct state intact.

requirements.title: Anti-automation and abuse limits
requirements.statement: Production deployments SHALL enforce benchmark-backed request, identity, tenant, query, upload, import, job, and expensive-operation rate and concurrency limits.
verification: Production edge/distributed abuse and saturation profile

requirements.title: Browser origin policy
requirements.statement: CORS and preview messaging SHALL accept only absent origins where safe or exact configured origins; postMessage payloads SHALL pass exact origin/source and schema validation.

requirements.title: Browser response hardening
requirements.statement: Production HTML and sensitive file responses SHALL use a reviewed CSP, nosniff, anti-framing policy, referrer policy, and other browser headers appropriate to their embedding contract.

requirements.title: Trusted intermediary headers
requirements.statement: Production identity, origin, client-IP, scheme, and host decisions SHALL use only headers installed by explicitly trusted intermediaries and unavailable for caller override.
verification: Production proxy and identity conformance test

requirements.title: Bounded GraphQL execution
requirements.statement: GraphQL SHALL bound depth, aliases, amount, input size, and execution cost; batching/subscriptions SHALL remain disabled unless separately threat-modeled; production introspection SHALL follow deployment policy.
verification: Production introspection and edge-concurrency policy review

requirements.title: Safe file admission and storage
requirements.statement: Every accepted upload SHALL have documented type/size rules, server-side size and content verification, internally generated storage keys, malware policy, quarantine, and safe download behavior.
verification: Deployment quota and scanner conformance test

requirements.title: Authentication pathways
requirements.statement: Before production use, every user and service authentication pathway SHALL be documented and consistently verify trusted issuer, signature, audience, time, nonce/replay semantics, subject namespace, and required authentication strength.

requirements.title: Session lifecycle
requirements.statement: Production browser sessions SHALL be backend-verified, CSPRNG-generated with at least 128 bits of entropy, bounded by documented idle/absolute lifetimes, rotated at authentication, and invalid after logout, expiry, account disablement, or administrative revocation.

requirements.title: Deny-by-default scoped authorization
requirements.statement: Every non-public operation SHALL authorize its function and object at a trusted layer; unmatched roles/grants SHALL be denied and the complete organization/tenant/workspace/site/environment/locale scope SHALL be non-bypassable.

requirements.title: Signed token purpose and scope
requirements.statement: Self-contained grants SHALL use a fixed approved MAC algorithm, trusted key source, signature verification before claims, explicit purpose/audience, complete relevant scope, expiry, and constant-time comparison.

requirements.title: OIDC browser-flow binding
requirements.statement: A production OIDC client SHALL keep tokens only in components that need them and bind authorization responses to the initiating browser session using unpredictable state, nonce, and PKCE where applicable.

requirements.title: Cryptographic inventory and key lifecycle
requirements.statement: GridStory deployments SHALL maintain an inventory and lifecycle for every signing, hashing, encryption, certificate, and service credential, with separate purposes, approved algorithms, owners, storage, rotation, and emergency revocation.
verification: Deployment secret inventory and rotation exercise

requirements.title: Approved cryptographic primitives
requirements.statement: Application cryptography SHALL use the Node.js platform crypto implementation, SHA-256/HMAC-SHA-256 or stronger approved primitives, constant-time verification, and CSPRNG values with at least 128 bits of entropy where unpredictability is required.

requirements.title: Protected communications
requirements.statement: Production external and service-to-service communication SHALL use TLS 1.2 or 1.3 without plaintext fallback and SHALL validate server certificates against configured trust roots.
verification: Production TLS and adapter transport scan

requirements.title: External dependency configuration
requirements.statement: Every database, storage, search, cache, IdP, scanner, webhook, and notification connection SHALL document scope, authentication, least privilege, destinations, timeouts, connection/concurrency limits, retries, failure behavior, and health signals.

requirements.title: Production-safe configuration
requirements.statement: Production startup and deployment SHALL reject development identity, default/short secrets, debug exposure, unsafe origins, unbounded external destinations, public object storage, and missing durable adapters required by the selected topology.

requirements.title: Sensitive-data classification
requirements.statement: GridStory SHALL classify draft/published content, identity attributes, credentials/tokens, private assets, audit/operational data, and telemetry, with explicit access, encryption, logging, caching, retention, export, and deletion rules.

requirements.title: Credential and cache containment
requirements.statement: Credentials, preview grants, service tokens, and sensitive draft/private responses SHALL not enter public URLs or shared caches; sensitive responses SHALL use private, no-store and published caches SHALL contain published data only.

requirements.title: Vulnerability and component lifecycle
requirements.statement: The project SHALL maintain risk-based vulnerability remediation timeframes, a current SBOM from trusted locked dependencies, provenance/signatures, and a documented disclosure and support policy.
verification: Hosted OSV, SBOM, provenance, and attestation verification during staged release

requirements.title: Resource-demand inventory
requirements.statement: The project SHALL identify resource-demanding functions and publish tested limits for bodies, queries, uploads, archives, indexes, histories, queues, retries, concurrency, and retention.

requirements.title: Minimal response and explicit assignment
requirements.statement: APIs SHALL return only authorized required fields, use explicit schemas for mutable fields, and SHALL NOT bind arbitrary client objects to persisted models.

requirements.title: Security-event logging and audit
requirements.statement: GridStory SHALL inventory logs and record correlatable authentication, authorization failure, privileged mutation, publication, workflow/release, import/export, credential, adapter, and security-control events without recording secrets or unnecessary content.

requirements.title: Safe error handling
requirements.statement: Unhandled and security-sensitive failures SHALL return a generic stable envelope, SHALL not expose internal details, and SHALL fail closed without applying the protected operation.

requirements.title: Capability-isolated plugin execution
requirements.statement: Plugin installation and execution SHALL verify publisher-bound signed metadata and artifact digest, enforce SDK compatibility and tenant-scoped least-privilege grants, keep arbitrary plugin modules outside the control-plane process, bound every mediated invocation, and fail closed on disabled, revoked, unhealthy, missing, or invalid runtime state.

requirements.title: Guarded data governance and erasure
requirements.statement: Governance access SHALL be completely tenant scoped and private; exports SHALL inventory only explicit subject links; holds and restrictions SHALL dominate deletion; irreversible effects SHALL require an exact dry-run digest, a distinct authorized approver, fresh reauthentication, recent verified backup evidence, and execution-time policy/resource/key/placement revalidation with an attributable receipt.

requirements.title: Guarded read-only CMS migration and cutover evidence
requirements.statement: CMS migration sources SHALL be trusted server-composed, read-only, same-origin HTTPS, bounded, and credential-private; migration state SHALL be completely tenant scoped and no-store; target mutations SHALL require the exact reviewed dry-run digest, detect source/target/project/recipe drift, recover idempotently without early checkpoint advancement, preserve source deletions, and pass normal content governance and publication gates; cutover reports SHALL state their observed content-only boundary and SHALL NOT switch traffic.

requirements.title: Evidence-bound marketplace publisher and release trust
requirements.owner: Marketplace trust and plugin platform owner
requirements.statement: Marketplace state SHALL be completely tenant scoped and private; publisher trust SHALL require an exact expiring DNS possession proof plus a distinct evidence-referenced human approval and immediate suspension; releases SHALL be immutable, publisher/key/signature/digest bound, and compatibility/support/capability transparent; automated review SHALL use only a configured trusted non-executing inspector, bind current SBOM/provenance/inventory/malware/vulnerability/license evidence to the exact artifact, fail closed, and require a distinct human release approver; marketplace installation SHALL revalidate current trust and install disabled without automatic capability grants.

requirements.title: Consent-aware deterministic targeting and cache isolation
requirements.statement: Targeting configuration SHALL be completely tenant scoped with private draft preview and exact published revision separation; runtime context SHALL accept only declared bounded typed attributes and purposes, SHALL fail closed on absent or denied required consent and configured GPC suppression, and SHALL NOT persist subject profiles; decisions SHALL be deterministic with a required fallback; shared-cache guidance SHALL be emitted only for public consent-independent inputs and SHALL bind complete scope, published revision, resource, and every varying input, while personal, authentication, consent-dependent, and preview decisions SHALL remain private or no-store.

requirements.title: Governed consent-aware content experiments
requirements.owner: Experimentation, privacy, analytics, and delivery owner
requirements.statement: Experiment state SHALL be completely tenant scoped with distinct private management permissions; started designs SHALL be immutable, pin exact published targeting, and exclude placement overlap; public allocation SHALL require configured consent, hash an application-generated random per-experiment token without persisting or echoing token/bucket/context, and remain no-store; metric evidence SHALL be complete bounded immutable aggregates with an external digest and enforced allocation/sample/absolute guardrails; promotion SHALL require a completed unchanged experiment and explicit supported treatment and SHALL atomically update only the targeting draft without statistical-significance, automatic-winner, or publication claims.

requirements.title: Minimized consent-aware content analytics and isolated adapter delivery
requirements.owner: Analytics, privacy, operations, and delivery owner
requirements.statement: Public analytics SHALL accept only a bounded closed anonymous event union after the configured purpose grant and received GPC check, derive complete scope from trusted request context, and validate the exact current published content revision while rejecting identity, arbitrary properties, and draft/preview data; normalized lifecycle, bounded aggregates, private receipts, and release annotations SHALL be completely tenant scoped and idempotent; adapter delivery SHALL use independent durable retries with provider credentials outside schema/core and generic retained failures, and SHALL NOT alter authoritative content/release state; authenticated reports SHALL omit raw evidence and receipt IDs and expose explicit truncation while deployment rate, egress, retention, deletion, provider, and statistical controls remain external evidence.

requirements.title: Governed provider-neutral AI generation and scoped retrieval
requirements.owner: AI governance, security, platform, and editorial owner
requirements.statement: AI policy and usage SHALL be completely tenant scoped with distinct private read/manage/execute permissions, immutable active prompts, explicit allowed provider/models, conservative bounded request/input/output/cost reservations, metadata-only receipts, and accountable kill-switch events; every explicit retrieval source SHALL be reauthorized for the configured perspective/content type and only positive allowlisted field paths may leave the CMS; credential/email/phone/IP redaction SHALL run before provider egress and after response; provider requests SHALL omit tenant routing and expose no tools or mutation authority; estimates/results SHALL be strictly validated, diagnostics generic, timeouts bounded, duplicate IDs denied, output marked untrusted, failed reservations retained, and state/prompt/model rechecked during atomic settlement so disablement discards in-flight output.

requirements.title: Reviewed AI authoring and tenant-safe private semantic search
requirements.owner: AI governance, security, platform, search, and editorial owner
requirements.statement: AI authoring policy and evaluated proposals SHALL be completely tenant scoped, bounded, optimistic, private/no-store, and disabled by default; generation SHALL require a known enabled action, exact current draft, fixed structured-output contract, declared top-level text/slug changes, complete candidate validation, deterministic evaluation, and exact prompt/model/source/target/usage/redaction provenance without raw provider or source retention; ai.review SHALL be distinct, human-user-only, one-time, revision-rechecked, and SHALL never save, transition, approve workflow, or publish content; semantic indexing SHALL use only positively allowlisted redacted text/slug fields through injected tenant-aware adapters and identifier-only durable jobs, persist no query/vector body, treat indexes as derived, and fail closed unless every result has exact adapter/model/scope/perspective/current-revision/allowed-field/finite-score/unique-ID provenance plus ordinary content authorization.

requirements.title: Tenant-safe regional published delivery and reviewed single-writer failover
requirements.owner: Platform, operations, security, and delivery owner
requirements.statement: Regional policy, evidence, plans, approvals, results, and delivery reads SHALL be completely tenant scoped, bounded, optimistic, private by default, disabled by default, and authorized through distinct read/manage/failover actions; trusted deployment composition SHALL select the local region and inject least-authority published-read and failover adapters; every content result and adapter attestation SHALL match exact scope, perspective, revision, adapter, region, topology, time, lag, residency, and cache partition requirements; shared caching SHALL require complete partition evidence; switchovers SHALL require current residency, verified backup, zero-loss planned readiness or explicit bounded emergency loss, an expiring digest, a different recently reauthenticated human approver, persisted execution, stable idempotency, ambiguous reconciliation, and a success result proving only the target writable before topology advances and delivery resets to primary-only; adapter diagnostics, credentials, raw replication positions, preview credentials, and drafts SHALL NOT enter public bodies, headers, caches, logs, or persisted regional state.

requirements.title: Signed published-only federation with pinned attribution and reviewed read-only mirrors
requirements.owner: Platform, security, content governance, legal, and delivery owner
requirements.statement: Federation offers, agreements, mirror plans, records, tombstones, and receipts SHALL be completely tenant scoped, bounded, optimistic, private for management, no-store for public delivery, disabled by default, and governed by distinct federation read/manage/consume/sync permissions; producers SHALL allowlist exact supported deployed schema versions and emit only signed published revisions without drafts, previews, assets, components, relations, rich text, credentials, or workflow state; consumers SHALL pin and verify Ed25519 key, request/time, source instance/scope, offer version/digest, schema fingerprints, requested identity, monotonic revision, checksum, snapshot checkpoint, and mandatory canonical/license/credit/agent attribution; HTTP sources SHALL be configured credential-free HTTPS origins with no redirects, same-origin response validation, complete source scope, bounded time/bytes/records, and generic failures; live delivery SHALL retain no record, mirrors SHALL remain separate/read-only and require an expiring digest-reviewed source-revalidated atomic idempotent plan with blockers and withdrawal tombstones, and public output SHALL omit remote scope, adapter/key configuration, credentials, and diagnostics while source rights, key rotation, egress, and availability remain external evidence.

requirements.title: Tenant-safe derived knowledge and human-reviewed least-authority agent draft operations
requirements.owner: AI governance, security, platform, knowledge, and editorial owner
requirements.statement: Knowledge graph and recommendation responses SHALL be private/no-store, derived from authoritative current relation/taxonomy content, completely tenant scoped, per-entry authorized, revision bound, cycle safe, finitely bounded, explicitly truncated, and deterministic with every visible contribution exactly summing to each score and no hidden identity, behavior, analytics, semantic, model, popularity, or exploration signal; knowledge-agent policy, plans, reviews, execution state, and receipts SHALL be complete-scope, optimistic, bounded, recoverable, disabled by default, and separately authorized; an injected runtime SHALL receive only a redacted bounded goal and fixed strictly parsed, counted, per-call-authorized read tools with no ambient repository, network, credential, plugin, filesystem, shell, workflow, release, publication, or write capability; final output SHALL target one exact saved draft and only positively allowlisted top-level text/slug fields, pass complete candidate validation, expose rationale and metadata-only tool provenance, and bind current policy/runtime/model/prompt/target/result/expiry evidence; review SHALL be one-time and human-user-only without mutation, while execution SHALL additionally require ordinary exact-target draft-update authorization, revalidate all evidence, persist before mutation, be idempotent/reconcilable, use normal draft revision history, and SHALL NOT create/delete, affect multiple entries, edit rich/relation/taxonomy/component/asset data, transition workflow/release state, or publish.

requirements.title: Generated minimized interoperability and tenant-safe pull-only fleet observation
requirements.owner: Platform, security, interoperability, and self-hosted operations owner
requirements.statement: Public interoperability documents SHALL be generated from canonical runtime input contracts, use stable versioned identities and canonical digests, fail byte-for-byte drift checks, describe semantic invariants separately, and expose only configured instance/service/protocol/specification metadata with bounded public caching and no scope, content, draft, component inventory, credential, adapter, fleet, or live-status data; preview source maps SHALL target only existing preview-only node attributes and SHALL NOT annotate published rendering; fleet state SHALL be empty by default, complete-scope, optimistic, bounded, private/no-store, recoverable, and protected by distinct read/manage/check authority; checks SHALL use only configured adapter IDs and deployment-controlled credential-free HTTPS origins, accept no caller URL or credential, perform exact bounded GET-only no-redirect same-origin discovery/health/readiness reads, strictly validate freshness, expected instance/service/protocol and every specification digest, retain only sanitized generation-bound Reachable/Ready/Compatible conditions, project expired evidence as Unknown, and SHALL NOT provide discovery scans, inbound enrollment, agents, schedules, secrets, shell, remote writes, provisioning, deployment, upgrade, rollback, traffic, content, workflow, release, or publication authority.
